name: AFTERBURNER
title: Afterburner: push a jet engine through the detent
desc: Run a generic afterburning jet engine on a test stand: push the lever through the detent, light the afterburner, slam it and stall the compressor. See it in cutaway, schlieren and thermal.
alt: A jet engine on a test stand at night with its afterburner lit, from Throttle Up.

name: SR-71'S J58
title: SR-71: run the Blackbird's J58 engine
desc: Run the SR-71 Blackbird's J58 on a test stand: start it from the start cart, light the afterburner and watch the inlet spike move as the simulated Mach number climbs. Every fact cites its source.
alt: The SR-71's J58 engine on a test stand at dusk with its afterburner lit, from Throttle Up.

name: RS-25
title: RS-25: run the Space Shuttle main engine
desc: Run the Space Shuttle's main engine on a vertical test stand: the hydrogen burn-off igniters, ignition, steam, and the throttle up to full power. Every fact cites its source.
alt: An RS-25 rocket engine firing on a vertical test stand, from Throttle Up.

name: HALL THRUSTER
title: Hall thruster: fly an electric engine in Earth orbit
desc: Run a Hall thruster on a spacecraft in Earth orbit: faint thrust, a tiny flow of xenon, and a time warp to watch it raise the orbit. Every fact cites its source.
alt: A spacecraft with a glowing Hall thruster above the Earth, from Throttle Up.

name: SATURN V
title: Saturn V: light all five F-1 engines
desc: Light the five F-1 engines of the Saturn V's first stage on a static test stand, in the real 1-2-2 order. Every fact cites its source.
alt: Five F-1 engines firing under a Saturn V first stage on a test stand at night, from Throttle Up.

name: HARRIER
title: Harrier: hover a jump jet on its own thrust
desc: Hover a Harrier on its Pegasus engine: one lever for thrust, one for the nozzles. Then try the deck landing on a ship at sea, scored. Every fact cites its source.
alt: A Harrier jump jet hovering above its pad, from Throttle Up.

daily.title: Daily challenge: land the Harrier on the deck
daily.desc: Today's challenge, the same for everyone: slide a hovering Harrier over a ship's heaving deck and land on spot 5. Scored on softness, accuracy and time.

name: NK-12
title: NK-12: run the turboprop with contra-rotating propellers
desc: Run the Kuznetsov NK-12 turboprop on a test stand: two propellers turning opposite ways, speed held steady while the blades take a bigger bite. Every fact cites its source.
alt: The NK-12 turboprop with its contra-rotating propellers on a test stand, from Throttle Up.

name: MARS SKY CRANE
title: Mars sky crane: lower Perseverance to the ground
desc: Fly the Mars 2020 descent stage: hold the hover on eight engines, lower the Perseverance rover on its bridles and set it down in Jezero Crater. Every fact cites its source.
alt: The Mars 2020 descent stage lowering the Perseverance rover on bridles above Mars, from Throttle Up.

daily.title: Daily challenge: land the Mars sky crane
daily.desc: Today's challenge, the same for everyone: lower the Perseverance rover on its bridles and touch down at 0.75 m/s or less, on a limited load of hydrazine. Scored.

name: STARSHIP SUPER HEAVY
title: Starship Super Heavy: light all 33 Raptors
desc: Static-fire Starship's Super Heavy booster on its launch mount at Starbase: light the centre three, the middle ring and the outer ring, then throttle all 33 engines to full. Every fact cites its source.
alt: Aerial view of a Starship Super Heavy booster firing on its launch mount at dusk, flame pouring out of the trench both ways, from Throttle Up.

name: APOLLO LUNAR MODULE
title: Apollo lunar module: land on the Moon
desc: Fly the Apollo lunar module's last hundred feet: set the sink rate a foot per second at a time, stop the drift and touch down inside the landing gear's limits before the bingo call. Every fact cites its source.
alt: The Apollo lunar module descending on its engine just above the Moon, dust streaking out along the ground, from Throttle Up.

daily.title: Daily challenge: land the Apollo lunar module
daily.desc: Today's challenge, the same for everyone: stop the drift, land the lunar module softly and beat the bingo call, the point 20 seconds before the tanks run dry. Scored.
